Settings.OpenHint: Opens the window with all measurements (interface in German). Shortcut: Alt + Shift + P.
Settings.WatchHint: Continuously measures module run times, stutters, files and console. Turn off when not needed (applies after reload).
Settings.ConsoleHint: Counts errors, warnings and deprecated calls per module. Side effect: browser dev tools show this module as the sender of messages (applies after reload).
Settings.NotifyHint: Shows detected problems as notifications at the top of the screen.
Settings.RefreshHint: Refreshes the live view every 2.5 seconds.
Settings.RemoteHint: The GM may collect measurements from player browsers (browser, GPU, FPS, module run times, problems).
Settings.limitImageMBHint: Larger image files are reported as a problem.
Settings.limitAudioMBHint: Larger audio files are reported as a problem.
Settings.limitVideoMBHint: Larger video files are reported as a problem.
